sentences.text: Scutellosaurus represents one of the earliest known forms of armored dinosaurs and is currently recognized as the most basal member of this group discovered to date.
Hundreds of osteoderms, or bony plates, were arranged in up to five parallel rows along the neck, back, and extending as far as the tail tip.
The animal possessed an unusually long tail that likely served as a counterbalance to its heavy armored body, occupying two-thirds of the total body length.
Scutellosaurus is the most abundant dinosaur species known from the Kayenta Formation.
The first skeletons of Scutellosaurus were found in June 1971 by David Lawler, an intern at the Museum of Northern Arizona.
The holotype specimen includes over 300 osteoderms, numerous vertebrae, limb bones, and partial skull fragments.
Scutellosaurus belongs to the parent group Thyreophora.
Scutellosaurus is classified in the class Ornithischia.
Scutellosaurus serves as the nominal genus for the clade Scutellosauridae, a group coined in 1990.
Fossils of Scutellosaurus are found in the Kayenta Formation, which is exposed on the Navajo Nation land in northern Arizona.
